We store transaction amounts as exact integers in minor units (bigint) alongside their ISO 4217 currency code, which avoids floating-point rounding errors entirely. Currencies without minor units, such as the Japanese yen, are stored directly as whole units according to currency-aware multiplier rules in the architecture.
